record.question: What is the primary objective of the 'IMPRINT' (IMpacting Research INnovation and Technology) initiative in India?
options: To identify and solve major science and engineering challenges relevant to India through a pan-IIT and IISc joint initiative.
To provide scholarships for students studying abroad in STEM fields.
To regulate the ethics of Artificial Intelligence in healthcare.
To digitize all historical scientific manuscripts available in Indian libraries.
